body:
The nearest Lupine field is only behind the corner of my house. So of course I went to pick my bag full of Nootka Lupine (at least the Lupine I picked looked like Nootka Lupine). After picking I decided to dry the Lupine leaves and flowers so they could be lit more easily in my bongs bowl. After two days I decided to grind leaves and flowers to small bits, the result looked like oregano... After grinding, I filled my bowl of bong and lit it.
I was a bit suspicious about Lupine as a drug. And I have to admit that I still am. After taking two bowls I went to lie on my bed, relaxed and waited for a trip to rise but all I got was slight headache and few short-term memory problems while talking to my friend.
At least I now know that Nootka Lupine of Finland doesn't work as an alternative for cannabis.
